name: Waiting on approval
when: Needs a yes before it runs, sends or shares

variants.name: Sign
variants.desc: Holds up a sign with an empty checkbox that pulses.

variants.name: Foot tap
variants.desc: Taps one side on the floor and glances up, politely waiting.

variants.name: Desk bell
variants.desc: Rings a little desk bell, then looks back at you.

variants.name: Puppy eyes
variants.desc: Big shiny eyes, a head tilt and a hopeful wiggle.

variants.name: Sign here
variants.desc: Points a pen at the signature line and looks up at you.

parts.t: <g class="cheeks"><ellipse cx="{{a.ck1}}" cy="{{a.cky}}" rx="6" ry="3.4"></ellipse><ellipse cx="{{a.ck2}}" cy="{{a.cky}}" rx="6" ry="3.4"></ellipse></g>
<g class="eg eg-shine" fill="#FFFFFF"><circle cx="{{a.shx1}}" cy="{{a.shy1}}" r="1.9"></circle><circle cx="{{a.shx2}}" cy="{{a.shy2}}" r="1.9"></circle></g>

<g class="fx-sign" transform="translate(0 {{a.up}})"><g transform="translate(50 17)"><g class="a sgn"><path class="thin" d="M0 0V-10"></path><rect class="pw" x="-14" y="-26" width="28" height="17" rx="2"></rect><rect class="a cbx" x="-10" y="-21" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="none" stroke-width="1.8" style="stroke: var(--aa-ink, #3A3833)"></rect><path class="line2" d="M0 -19.5H9M0 -15H6"></path></g></g></g>
<g class="fx-tapmk" transform="translate(0 {{a.dn}})"><g transform="translate(25 79)"><path class="a tpk thin" d="M-2 -5L-5 -8M-4 -1H-8.5M-2 3L-5 5.5"></path></g></g>

<g class="fx-bell" transform="translate({{a.side}} {{a.dn}})"><g transform="translate(93 81)"><rect class="dk" x="-9" y="-2.5" width="18" height="2.5" rx="1"></rect><path class="gold" d="M-7 -2.5A7 7 0 0 1 7 -2.5Z"></path><g class="a bbtn"><rect class="dk" x="-1.2" y="-12.5" width="2.4" height="3.5" rx="1"></rect></g><path class="a dng thin" d="M-8 -12L-11.5 -15M8 -12L11.5 -15M-10 -7H-14M10 -7H14"></path><g transform="translate(0 -17)"><g class="a paw"><ellipse class="hc" cx="0" cy="0" rx="4" ry="3.2"></ellipse></g></g></g></g>

<g class="fx-sigdoc" transform="translate(0 {{a.dn}})"><g transform="translate(50 78)"><rect class="pw" x="-16" y="-11" width="32" height="22" rx="2"></rect><path class="line2" d="M-11 -6H11M-11 -2H5"></path><path class="thin" d="M-12.5 3L-9.5 6M-9.5 3L-12.5 6"></path><path class="lnk2" d="M-6 6H12"></path><g transform="translate(5 4)"><g class="a hov"><g transform="rotate(28)"><path class="dk" d="M0 0L-1.6 -4.5H1.6Z"></path><rect class="gst" x="-1.8" y="-15" width="3.6" height="10.5" rx=".6"></rect><rect class="cst" x="-1.8" y="-18" width="3.6" height="3" rx="1"></rect></g></g></g></g></g>
